name_note: GTDB g__Escherichia also contains the genomes named Shigella in NCBI, because Shigella sits phylogenetically inside Escherichia coli.

sentences.text: Escherichia coli is a facultatively anaerobic Gram-negative rod whose primary habitat is the vertebrate gut, where it is the predominant aerobic organism.
In healthy human adults the gut carries a mixture of long-lived resident Escherichia coli strains and short-lived transient strains.
The pathogen genus Shigella is genomically part of Escherichia coli, and the species as a whole is highly diverse in genome structure.
Published work associates particular lineages with disease: enterotoxigenic Escherichia coli has been reported as a major cause of diarrhoea in children and travellers in developing countries.
